title: Traditional Venezuelan Banana Bread
description: A moist and delicious banana bread infused with the flavors of Venezuela. Perfect for a snack or dessert.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: make sure to have gluten-free option available

ingredients.name: unsalted butter, softened
ingredients.notes: use vegan butter for a dairy-free option

ingredients.name: granulated sugar
ingredients.notes: you can also use brown sugar for a different flavor

ingredients.name: vanilla extract
ingredients.notes: use high-quality vanilla for the best flavor

ingredients.name: baking powder
ingredients.notes: make sure it's fresh for the best results

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: use kosher salt for a more complex flavor

instructions: Grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan and set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, mash the bananas with a fork until they're smooth.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Add the softened butter to the dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
Add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition.
Add the dry ingredients to the banana mixture and mix until just combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 55-60 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Let the bread cool in the pan for 10 minutes before transferring it to a wire rack to cool completely.
